Pricing

How much does lawn mowing cost?
One flat monthly price, set for your yard. Enter your address and we measure your grass from the county parcel record. Plans from $169 a month. Over half an acre: photo quote.
How do you know my lot size?
Enter your address and we read the lot size from the county parcel record. No estimate visit needed. If we cannot match your address, or the lot is over half an acre, send a few photos and we reply with a price.
Are there any other fees?
No sign-up fee. If the lawn is overgrown at the first visit, a one-time catch-up starting at $49 is added to your first month only.
What's included in every visit?
Mow, trim, and blow off the driveway, walkways and porch. The plan is mowing only: hedges, weeding, fertilizer and cleanups are not part of it.

Scheduling

How often will you mow?
Weekly from April to October and every 2 weeks from November to March. That is about 41 cuts a year, for the same monthly price all year.
Do I need to be home when you mow?
No. As long as we can reach the yard you are all set. If there is a gate, add the code or access notes when you sign up.
Which day will you come?
We mow by street, so you get the same day each visit. We tell you your day when you sign up.
What happens if it rains on my day?
Rain days are made up, not skipped. We come back as soon as the yard is dry enough to mow.

Billing

When do I get charged?
Nothing is charged when you sign up. Your first month is charged on the day of your first cut, then the plan renews monthly until you cancel.
How do I pay?
Card on autopay, or an emailed monthly invoice.
Can I cancel anytime?
Yes. Month to month, no contract and no cancellation penalty. Call or text (352) 462-0627 to cancel; service runs to the end of the month already paid.
I already pay per visit. Does anything change for me?
No. Current customers keep their existing service and billing unless they choose to switch to a monthly plan.
What's your refund policy?
If you are unhappy with a visit, contact us within 48 hours and we will come back and fix it. See the full Refund Policy for details.

Service area

Do you serve my area?
We mow in Citrus Springs (34433, 34434), Dunnellon (34431, 34432) and Beverly Hills (34464, 34465), Florida. Enter your address to confirm your street.
Do you serve commercial properties?
Right now we focus on homes. For a commercial property, call (352) 462-0627.
